name: Newsprint
description: Aged newspaper stock with halftone dots, a double masthead rule, double-line boxes and a classic serif.
prompt: Classic newspaper: aged off-white newsprint with a faint halftone dot texture, a thick-and-thin double rule under the headline, boxes framed in black double lines with square corners, a single red ink accent, a classic book serif. Serious, credible and timeless.
